title: Harnessing dual forms of water energy for all-weather high-performance electricity generation using amorphous slurry
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01315A, Paper
Wenna Ge, Quanmao Wei, Wenzong Li, Xu Wang, Chenguang Lu, Keke Zhang, Xuanqi Luo, Lemin Zhang, Yu Sun, Yahua Liu
Mimicking seaweed mud, we developed a dual-mode water-driven electricity generator (DWEG) that harvests energy from both moisture absorption and water evaporation. Integrated DWEG arrays successfully powered a tablet computer without external power.
